meta.title: GROW Automation comprehensive MVP UI requirements
meta.provenance: Documentation audit supplement to the original GROW UX and Codex prompt library.
meta.status: Active requirement baseline for productionization of the boardroom-ready GROW Automation app.

globalRequirements: UI-G01 preserve route and action inventory
UI-G02 represent mock evidence separately from production claims
UI-G03 use native SAP UI5/Fiori patterns
UI-G04 use Horizon light theme with semantic tokens
UI-G05 provide one primary action and clear secondary hierarchy
UI-G06 keep project/persona/environment context visible
UI-G07 use dynamic header, content sections and task-appropriate footer/actions
UI-G08 preserve list context when opening detail
UI-G09 support direct route, refresh and back navigation without blank pages
UI-G10 make all seven phase labels navigable
UI-G11 use responsive tables by default
UI-G12 support search, clear filters and no-results states
UI-G13 provide stable sort and critical columns
UI-G14 persist variant settings by user and context
UI-G15 separate row selection, navigation and action links
UI-G16 evaluate bulk actions per record
UI-G17 require typed validation and searchable value help
UI-G18 apply deterministic validation and boundary fixtures
UI-G19 distinguish observed, proposed and approved values
UI-G20 protect unsaved work with Save/Discard/Cancel
UI-G21 use field state plus message summary
UI-G22 show completion feedback only after state effect succeeds
UI-G23 support loading, empty, denied, stale and failed states
UI-G24 ensure every visible action has a meaningful outcome
UI-G25 replace unavailable actions with blocker/permission review
UI-G26 enforce persona/project authorization in backend checks
UI-G27 separate author, approver, release authority and auditor roles
UI-G28 show version, target, risk, evidence and owner before approval
UI-G29 verify prerequisites before dependent dispatch
UI-G30 distinguish queued, dispatched, failed, reconciling and verified outcomes
UI-G31 reconcile uncertain writes before retry
UI-G32 pause prevents new dispatch while preserving evidence
UI-G33 show bounded agent goal, plan, sources and validation
UI-G34 expose rationale and citations without fabricated hidden reasoning
UI-G35 provide assistant shell panel and phone full-screen conversation
UI-G36 support 12+ bounded assistant intents
UI-G37 limit conversation visibility to role/project scope
UI-G38 show all five SAP integration systems and state metadata
UI-G39 keep identifiers scoped and distinct by object type
UI-G40 use deterministic seeded synthetic records and a fixed demo clock
UI-G41 separate specification, fixtures and runtime state
UI-G42 show metric basis and numerator/denominator context
UI-G43 generate real scoped exports with simulation labels
UI-G44 validate 360, 768, 1024 and 1440 viewports
UI-G45 use progressive disclosure and one-column phone alternatives
UI-G46 provide accessible labels, focus and keyboard support
UI-G47 announce status and errors without color-only semantics
UI-G48 format locale/date/number values correctly
UI-G49 use short labels and helpful error text
UI-G50 trace each UI requirement to control, fixture, persona and test
UI-G51 debounce search and prevent duplicate submit
UI-G52 use Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize Build, Realize Test, Deploy and Run labels
